"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))
"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import re
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_KEY_LINE = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*):(.*)$")
+_INTEGER = re.compile(r"^-?[0-9]+$")
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _parse_setting_value(raw: str) -> bool | int | str:
+    value = raw.strip()
+    if value == "true":
+        return True
+    if value == "false":
+        return False
+    if _INTEGER.match(value):
+        return int(value)
+    if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == '"' and value[-1] == '"':
+        return value[1:-1]
+    return value
+
+
+def handle_parse_settings(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    text = params.get("text")
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid settings"}
+    settings: dict = {}
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        match = _KEY_LINE.match(line)
+        if match is None:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid settings"}
+        key, raw_value = match.group(1), match.group(2)
+        if key in settings:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid settings"}
+        settings[key] = _parse_setting_value(raw_value)
+    return 200, {"settings": settings}

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/repo")
from app.api.handlers import handle_parse_settings as h

def eq(got, want, label):
    assert got == want, f"{label}: got {got!r} want {want!r}"

# basic
eq(h({"text": "a: 1\nb: true\nc: false\nd: hello\ne: \"quoted\"\nf: -5"}),
   (200, {"settings": {"a": 1, "b": True, "c": False, "d": "hello", "e": "quoted", "f": -5}}), "basic")

# blank lines, comments, whitespace trimming, empty value, value with colon
text = """
# a comment
   # indented comment

  key1 : not-valid
"""
eq(h({"text": "  a: 1  \n\n# c\n\t# d\nb:\nc: x:y\n"}),
   (200, {"settings": {"a": 1, "b": "", "c": "x:y"}}), "trim/comment/empty/colon")

# leading/trailing spaces in value trimmed
eq(h({"text": "a:    spaced   "}), (200, {"settings": {"a": "spaced"}}), "value trim")

# integers
eq(h({"text": "a: 0\nb: -0\nc: 12\nd: -12"}), (200, {"settings": {"a": 0, "b": 0, "c": 12, "d": -12}}), "ints")
# not integers -> strings
eq(h({"text": "a: +1\nb: 1.5\nc: -\nd: 1a\ne: - 1"}), (200, {"settings": {"a": "+1", "b": "1.5", "c": "-", "d": "1a", "e": "- 1"}}), "non-int")

# quotes
eq(h({"text": 'a: "5"\nb: "true"\nc: ""\nd: "-3"'}), (200, {"settings": {"a": "5", "b": "true", "c": "", "d": "-3"}}), "quotes")
# not fully wrapped -> string
eq(h({"text": 'a: "unterminated\nb: "mid"dle\nc: no"'}), (200, {"settings": {"a": '"unterminated', "b": '"mid"dle', "c": "no"}}), "bad quotes")
# wrapped quotes with colon inside
eq(h({"text": 'a: "x:y"'}), (200, {"settings": {"a": "x:y"}}), "quoted colon")

# invalid: missing / non-string
eq(h({}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}), "missing")
eq(h({"text": 123}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}), "non-string")
eq(h({"text": None}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}), "none")

# invalid lines
for bad in ["no colon line", "9abc: 1", ": 1", "a b: 1", "a:b c: 1\n9x: 2", "  "] + ["key : 1"]:
    eq(h({"text": bad}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}), f"bad {bad!r}")

# duplicates
eq(h({"text": "a: 1\nb: 2\na: 3"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}), "dup")
eq(h({"text": "a: 1\n# a: 2\na: 3"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}), "dup with comment")

# underscore key, digits in key
eq(h({"text": "_a1: 1\nA_B: 2"}), (200, {"settings": {"_a1": 1, "A_B": 2}}), "key forms")

# \r\n handling
eq(h({"text": "a: 1\r\nb: 2\r\n"}), (200, {"settings": {"a": 1, "b": 2}}), "crlf")

# empty text -> ok empty settings
eq(h({"text": ""}), (200, {"settings": {}}), "empty text")
eq(h({"text": "\n\n# only comments\n"}), (200, {"settings": {}}), "only comments")

print("ALL OK")
